what_they_do: Complement builds software for manufacturers that pulls data from the separate systems a factory already runs on, things like MES, ERP, and job costing/quoting tools, and analyzes it in real time to catch inefficiencies as they happen. Today that kind of cross-system check is usually a manual process: someone has to log into multiple tools or reconcile spreadsheets to notice a problem on the floor. Complement automates that monitoring and pushes out alerts instead, and markets itself on being fast to integrate with minimal setup effort.
theme_fit_rationale: Complement's core value is reading across fragmented shop-floor systems (MES, ERP, quoting) that don't talk to each other and consolidating them into one automated monitoring and alerting layer, replacing manual cross-system checks, which is the central pattern of Theme 2.
